examples.english: The cause of this phenomenon has not yet been determined.

notes:
{現象|げんしょう} refers to any observable event or occurrence, whether natural, social, or psychological. It is a formal, somewhat academic word used in both everyday and technical contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {現象|げんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a phenomenon occurs
- {現象|げんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}→観察：02558_kansatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to observe a phenomenon
- {現象|げんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explain a phenomenon
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な{現象|げんしょう}: a strange phenomenon

TYPES:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{現象|げんしょう}: natural phenomenon
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{現象|げんしょう}: social phenomenon
- ⟦{心理|しんり}→心理：03332_shinri⟧{現象|げんしょう}: psychological phenomenon
- ⟦{気象|きしょう}→気象：09943_kishou⟧{現象|げんしょう}: weather phenomenon

FORMS:
{現|げん} (appear, manifest) + {象|しょう} (image, form) — literally "a manifested form."
